title: Executive Signal Card and Contingency Ladder for Inference Economics
creator: Sofia Ramirez
description:
Purpose: Produce a concise, decision-ready exec packet (2 slides + appendix) that surfaces the month-to-month signal for inference unit economics across hosted and dedicated customers, and a contingency ladder of actions the leadership team can take if cost or latency metrics materially diverge from plan.

Scope: 1) Synthesize token-level cost, average latency P50/P95, and RKPI (requests per second per GPU) into a single Signal Card. 2) Map 3 scenario tiers (green/yellow/red) with concrete tactical playbooks: e.g., routing policy changes, temporary quantized SKU rollout, throttled burst policies, and customer communications. 3) Produce decision asks with impact estimates (delta $/token, expected latency tradeoffs, operational overhead). 4) Prepare an appendix with dashboards, model variant performance snapshots, and experiment summaries.

Why now: PM and Eng detect upward drift in per-token unit cost for streaming workloads correlated with larger customer sequences and a 12% increase in retry rates. QBR asks for a crisp cross-functional recommendation set and escalation plan that execs can action without deep technical context.

Deliverables: - 2-slide Exec Signal Card (one-slide summary; one-slide decision ladder) - Appendix with data tables, links to dashboards, and short experiment logs - Owner-run playbook for the first 72 hours after a red-tier alert - PR templates for customer comms and CS playbook

Success criteria: Leadership can select a single mitigant option and authorize a tradeoff within 24 hours; engineering has a clear rollback path and estimated cost impact within 48 hours.
